name: Marginalia
description: Read with a pen: highlight a passage, look a word up, copy it with a citation, or ask @margin about it.

color.description: the highlight's theme tone: default, good, warn, bad, dim or accent

answer.description: a command that answers @margin: prompt on stdin, answer on stdout; left out, it answers from the note

session.description: how the command starts and resumes a thread's session; {{props.id}} is its id (claude needs none)

actions.label: Highlight
actions.description: Highlight the passage, in a tone

actions.label: Define
actions.description: Look the words up in the note's glossary and write the meaning in the margin

actions.label: Cite
actions.description: Copy the passage with a citation to where it is from

agents.name: margin
agents.description: Answers a question about a passage in its margin thread; a later @margin there resumes it
